messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-1 — elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts observed in eu-central-1 inference gateway. Paging oncall and posting here. Incident INC-2026-04-14-03 created.

Maya Chen: noticed error spike at ~02:12 UTC. 502/504 and occasional upstream resets on /v1/generate and /v1/stream.

David Park: I'm on pager. Any customer-facing impact numbers?

Maya Chen: dashboards show ~18% of requests failing with 5xx in eu-central for last 8 minutes. P95 latency also rising.

SRE Pager: taking primary. First step: collect envoy stats and tail gateway logs. Ops, can you grab proxy logs and LB connection metrics?

ops-bot: running: tail -n 500 /var/log/gateway/proxy.log on ggw-euc-0..4. Envoy stats stream: /debug/stats.

Julia Kim: model-worker upstream shows burst of TLS handshakes failing to storage endpoint (s3-compat) starting 02:10 UTC. Several EHOSTUNREACH and ECONNRESET.

Platform Eng: confirmed no recent model rollouts. Model shards pinned in-region. No worker restarts observed. CPU/GPU normal.

Maya Chen: looks like object-store connectivity degraded in AZ-a. Could be provider network issue.

oncall-sre: mitigation options: 1) enable cross-region fallback for affected model families 2) flip a circuit-breaker to avoid overloading failing upstreams 3) temporarily prioritize premium customers and throttle dev keys.

Liaison (CS): I'll prepare status messaging. Which customers should we notify first?

Maya Chen: target customers currently with active sessions in eu-central; we have a list from telemetry. Also flag enterprise tenants for manual contact.

David Park: I recommend a staged fallback: route premium customers into us-west-2 immediately, then progressively move others as needed. Use reduced-context variants to keep cost down and speed up cold-starts.

oncall-sre: applying fallback policy for 'redwood-llama-65b' and 'open-xxl' with premium-first weight. Command (control-plane):

```
curl -s -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routing/fallback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"from_region":"eu-central-1","to_region":"us-west-2","model_families":["redwood-llama-65b","open-xxl"],"strategy":"tiered","tiers":{"premium":1.0,"standard":0.5},"max_context_tokens":2048}'
```

ops-bot: control-plane accepted change; propagation window ~30s.

Maya Chen: 90s after flip: eu-central 5xx down from 18% -> 7.5%. Cross-region latency increase ~140ms for routed requests.

Julia Kim: still seeing intermittent 502s with "upstream reset" from certain worker IPs. I suspect per-replica NIC flaps to storage AZ.

Platform Eng: starting ephemeral worker pool in us-west to absorb fallback traffic and reduce load on the cross-region pool.

```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy model-worker-redwood-65b --replicas=14
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/model-worker-redwood-65b
```

Platform Eng: scaled; new pods initializing, warm-up ETA ~50s.

Support Eng: applying temporary rate-limits for high-volume dev keys in eu-central to protect capacity. Commanding API gateway patch:

```
PATCH /api/v1/quotas/region/eu-central-1
{ "dev_keys_limit": 0.1 }
```

oncall-sre: also enabling prefix KV cache to reduce store reads while s3 is flaky:

```
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/flags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"prefix_kv_cache_enabled","scope":"eu-central-1","value":true}'
```

ops-bot: flag set successfully.

Maya Chen: after cache + fallback + scaling: 5xx decreased to ~2.8% and timeouts are much lower. Some premium customers now fully routed to us-west with stable responses.

David Park: we should add a short-lived circuit-breaker to stop retries that amplify failures to storage. Enabling retry_on_5xx=false and lowering max retries in gateway for eu-central:

```
# adjust gateway retry policy
curl -X PATCH https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/gateway/config \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"region":"eu-central-1","retry_on_5xx":false,"max_retries":1}'
```

ops-bot: gateway config updated.

Julia Kim: logs show retries were contributing to spikes; with retries off, error amplification reduced.

Liaison (CS): status page updated: "Investigating elevated errors in eu-central-1. Some requests are being routed to alternate regions; service degraded for a subset of customers. Next update at 03:30 UTC or sooner." Sent targeted DM to top 20 enterprise tenants.

Support Eng: raising billing/credits ticket for potential compensation and noting any quota exceptions.

Maya Chen: contacted cloud provider NOC at 02:22 UTC; they acknowledge packet loss impacting object storage endpoints in eu-central AZ-a. ETA unknown.

oncall-sre: propose next steps: 1) keep fallback active until storage stability confirmed 2) keep lightweight weight in eu-central (0.25) to serve local low-latency tolerant traffic 3) collect control-plane audit logs + provider packet-loss reports for RCA.

David Park: agreed. I'll take over the on-call handoff at 02:50 UTC. Preparing a concise handoff note with mitigations executed and current state.

oncall-sre: patching routing weights to reduce region load:

```
curl -X PATCH https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routing/weights \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"region":"eu-central-1","weight":0.25}'
```

ops-bot: weights updated.

Maya Chen: monitoring: last 10 minutes show stable 5xx ~2-3% and cross-region traffic ~18% for the affected families. P95 latency drift within acceptable bounds for routed requests.

Julia Kim: recommend follow-ups: 1) add per-replica storage network health metric and alert when TLS handshake errors > 0.5% 2) automate auto-enabling prefix cache when store error rate crosses threshold 3) run a dry-run failover test in staging.

Platform Eng: will file infra tickets to add per-az storage telemetry and create a controlled failover playbook test.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-04-14-03 severity SEV-1 -> SEV-2 (mitigated). Handoff to @David Park (oncall-backup) at 02:50 UTC.

David Park: ack, taking ownership. I'll monitor for two hours, coordinate with infra and CS, and draft a postmortem once root cause confirmed.

Liaison (CS): customers requested ETA; I told them we'll update by 03:30 UTC or sooner.

Support Eng: logging incident for billing review and customer credits; creating follow-up ticket CORR-2026-04-14-17.

Maya Chen: marking incident for postmortem. Capturing logs, control-plane audit trail, and cloud provider packet-loss report.

David Park: thanks everyone — please attach any relevant traces or debug dumps to the incident ticket. I'll post a postmortem draft after RCA.

incident-bot: thread archived to incidents after postmortem filed. :white_check_mark:
